40018976.author: पदार्थः
40018976.content: महात्मना great soul, राघवेण by Raghava, रावणम् Ravana, निहतम् killed, दृष्टवा seeing, राक्षस्यः Rakshasas, शोककर्शिताः stricken with grief, अन्तःपुरात् from the gynaeceum, विनिष्पेतुः rushed out

40018976.author: Translation
40018976.content: On seeing Ravana killed by the great soul Raghava, the Rakshasas from the gynaeceum stricken with grief rushed out.

40018977.author: पदार्थः
40018977.content: सुबहुशो: numerous Rakshasa women, वार्यमाणाः obstructed, क्षितिपांसुषु rolling in dust, वेष्ट्नत्यः encompassing, विमुक्तकेश्यः dishevelled, वत्सहताः young ones lost, गावःयथा like cows, शोकार्ताः crying

40018977.author: Translation
40018977.content: Numerous women, though obstructed, were rolling in dust, with dishevelled hair and crying like cows which had lost their calves.

40018978.author: पदार्थः
40018978.content: राक्षसैःसह along with Rakshasas, उत्तरेणद्वारेण northern gate, विनिष्क्रम्य coming out, हतम् killed, पतिम् husbands, विचिन्वन्त्वः crying, घोरम् dreadful, अयोधनम् battlefield, प्रविश्य entered, आर्यपुत्रेति O son, हानाथेति ha husband, वादिन्यः speaking, कबन्धाङ्काम् trunks, शोणितकर्दमाम् soaked in blood and mud, महीम् on ground, सर्वशः all over, परिपेतुःwent about

40018978.author: Translation
40018978.content: The Rakshasa women along with Rakshasas came out of the north gate and entered the battlefield screaming 'O son', 'O husband' and crying, seeing the trunks soaked in blood and mud on the ground and went about all over.

40018979.author: पदार्थः
40018979.content: राक्षसैःसह along with Rakshasas, उत्तरेणद्वारेण northern gate, विनिष्क्रम्य coming out, हतम् killed, पतिम् husbands, विचिन्वन्त्वः crying, घोरम् dreadful, अयोधनम् battlefield, प्रविश्य entered, आर्यपुत्रेति O son, हानाथेति ha husband, वादिन्यः speaking, कबन्धाङ्काम् trunks, शोणितकर्दमाम् soaked in blood and mud, महीम् on ground, सर्वशः all over, परिपेतुःwent about

40018979.author: Translation
40018979.content: The Rakshasa women along with Rakshasas came out of the north gate and entered the battlefield screaming 'O son', 'O husband' and crying, seeing the trunks soaked in blood and mud on the ground and went about all over.

40018980.author: पदार्थः
40018980.content: बाष्पपरिपूर्णाक्ष्यः eyes filled with tears, भर्तृशोकपरिजाताः on account of grief for their husbands, ताः they, हतयूथपाः leader lost, करेण्वःइव like female elephant, नर्द्नत्यः bellowing, विनेदुः roared

40018980.author: Translation
40018980.content: Bellowing like female elephants that had lost their husbands, the women roared eyes filled with tears on account of grief for their husbands.

40018981.author: पदार्थः
40018981.content: ताः they, महाकायम् gigantic body, महावीर्यम् extraordinary valour, महाद्युतिम् full of splendor, नीलाञ्जनचयोपमम् like heap of dark mountain, निहतम् killed, भूमौ on the ground, ददृशुः looked

40018981.author: Translation
40018981.content: They looked at the gigantic body of Ravana of extraordinary valour, full of splendor, killed and lying like a heap of dark mountain on the ground.

40018982.author: पदार्थः
40018982.content: ताः they, रणपांसुषु in the battlefield, शयानम् lying, पतिम् husband, सहसा precipitately, दृष्टवा seeing, छिन्नाः broken, वनलताइव like creepers in a garden, तस्य his, गात्रेषु limbs, निपेतुः fallen

40018982.author: Translation
40018982.content: In the battlefield they saw their husband lying, and precipitately fell on his limbs like broken creepers in a garden.

40018983.author: पदार्थः
40018983.content: काचित् indeed, बहुमानात् out of great respect, एनम् they, परिष्वज्य embracing, रुरोद ह roared aloud, काचित् some, चरणौ feet, आलम्ब्य holding, काचित् some, कण्ठे neck, अवलम्ब्य च started weeping

40018983.author: Translation
40018983.content: Indeed, out of respect some embraced him and roared aloud, some held his feet and wept, some held his neck and started weeping.

40018984.author: पदार्थः
40018984.content: काचित् some, भुजौ arms, उत्क्षिप्य throwing herself on ground, भूमौ on ground, सुपरिवर्तते rolled, काचित् some, हतस्य killed, वदनम् face, दृष्टवा seeing, मोहम् in delusion, उपागमत् holding

40018984.author: Translation
40018984.content: Some lifting their arms threw themselves on ground, some rolled, some beholding the dead Ravana's face became deluded.

40018985.author: पदार्थः
40018985.content: काचित् some, शिरः head, अङ्के lap, कृत्वा holding, मुखम् face, ईक्षती looking, तुषारैः nature sheds dew, पङ्कजम् इव like from lotus, मुखम् face, बाष्पैः tears, स्नापयन्ती flowed, रुरोद roared

40018985.author: Translation
40018985.content: One held his head on her lap, and one held his face and looking at it shed tears, like nature covers lotus with dew and roared.

40018986.author: पदार्थः
40018986.content: भुवि on the ground, निहतम् killed, पतिम् husband, रावणम् Ravana, दृष्टवा beholding, एवम् in that manner, आर्ताः afflicted, ताः they, बहुधा many, चुक्रुशुः again and again, शोकात् in sorrow, भूयः exceedingly, पर्यदेवयन् overcome with grief

40018986.author: Translation
40018986.content: Afflicted on beholding their husband Ravana, killed, and lying on the ground, the Rakshasa women again and again cried exceedingly in many ways overcome with grief.

40018987.author: पदार्थः
40018987.content: येन to whom, शक्रः Indra, वित्रासितः feared, येन to whom, यमः Yama, वित्रासितः feared, येन to whom, राजा king, वैश्रवणः Visrava, पुष्पकेण् Pushpaka, वियोजितः used by winning, येन to whom, रणे in war, गन्धर्वाणाम् Gandharvas, ऋषीणां च and ascetics, महात्मनाम् high souled, सुराणां च and Suras, भयम् fear, दत्तम् bestowed, सःअयम् he this, रणे battlefield, सतः lies, शेते asleep

40018987.author: Translation
40018987.content: "By whom Indra feared, by whom Yama feared, at whom king Visrava feared, by whom Pushpaka was deprived to Kubera in war, by whom Gandharvas and ascetics were afraid of, by whom high souled Suras were afraid of lies in the battlefield asleep."

40018988.author: पदार्थः
40018988.content: येन to whom, शक्रः Indra, वित्रासितः feared, येन to whom, यमः Yama, वित्रासितः feared, येन to whom, राजा king, वैश्रवणः Visrava, पुष्पकेण् Pushpaka, वियोजितः used by winning, येन to whom, रणे in war, गन्धर्वाणाम् Gandharvas, ऋषीणां च and ascetics, महात्मनाम् high souled, सुराणां च and Suras, भयम् fear, दत्तम् bestowed, सःअयम् he this, रणे battlefield, सतः lies, शेते asleep

40018988.author: Translation
40018988.content: "By whom Indra feared, by whom Yama feared, at whom king Visrava feared, by whom Pushpaka was deprived to Kubera in war, by whom Gandharvas and ascetics were afraid of, by whom high souled Suras were afraid of lies in the battlefield asleep."

40018989.author: पदार्थः
40018989.content: यः he who, असुरेभ्यः from Asuras, सुरेभ्योवा or Suras, तथा so also, पन्नगेभ्योऽपि Uragas also, भयम् fear, न विजानाति not known, तस्य his, मानुषात् by human, इदम् thus, भयम् experienced fear

40018989.author: Translation
40018989.content: "He, who did not know fear from Asuras or Uragas, experienced fear from a mortal."

40018990.author: पदार्थः
40018990.content: यः he who, देवतानाम् Devatas, तथा so also, दानवरक्षनाम् Danavas, Rakshasas, अवध्यः not be killed, सःअयम् he, पदातिना by walk, मानुषेण by a mortal, रणे in battle, हतः killed, शेते lies asleep

40018990.author: Translation
40018990.content: "He, whom Devatas, Danavas and Rakshasas could not kill, lies asleep, killed by a mortal who came by walk."

40018991.author: पदार्थः
40018991.content: यः he who, सुरैः Suras, हन्तुम् to kill, न शक्यः not possible, यक्षै: Yaksha, न not, तथा so also, असुरैः Asuras, न not, सः he, अयम् this, असत्त्वः weak, कश्चिदिव like one devoid of strength, मर्त्येन by death, मृत्युम् death, लम्भितः resting

40018991.author: Translation
40018991.content: "He, who could not be killed by Suras, Asuras or Yakshas, such a hero lies like a weak person devoid of strength, killed by a mortal, is resting."

40018992.author: पदार्थः
40018992.content: तस्य his, दुःखिताः grieving, ताःस्त्रियःएवम् those women in that way, वदन्त्य: roaring, रुरुदुः aloud, भूयःएव च lamented again, दुःखार्ताः afflicted with sorrow, पुनःपुनः again and again, विलेपुः cried

40018992.author: Translation
40018992.content: Those women grieving in that way roared aloud, lamenting again and again cried, afflicted by sorrow.

40018993.author: पदार्थः
40018993.content: सततम् always, हितवादिनाम् your welfare, सुहृदाम् dear and good at heart, अश्वण्वता not listened, मरणाय death, सीता Sita, आहृता brought, राक्षसाश्च Rakshasas, निपातिताः struck down, आत्मा च yourself, पातितः destroyed, समम् at a time, ते to you, एताःवयम् all of us, इदानीम् this way

40018993.author: Translation
40018993.content: "You did not listen to the good advice of your dear and good at heart. You brought Sita and destroyed yourself and all of us at a time."

40018994.author: पदार्थः
40018994.content: हितम् good, वाक्यम् words, ब्रुवाणोऽपि even though told, इष्टःभ्राता dear brother, विभीषणः Vibheeshana, धृष्टम् evidently, आत्मवथकाङ्णा sought your own destruction, त्वया by you, मोहात् in delusion, परुषितः harshly

40018994.author: Translation
40018994.content: "Even though good advice was given by your dear brother Vibheeshana, in your delusion evidently you sought your own destruction."

40018995.author: पदार्थः
40018995.content: मैतिली Mythili, सीता Sita, ते to you, रामाय Rama's, निर्यातिता returned, यदिस्यात् if so with you, नः not, मूलहरम् destruction of the very root, इदम् this, महत् great, घोरम् terrific, व्यसनम् calamity, न स्यात् not happened

40018995.author: Translation
40018995.content: "If Sita, princess of Mithila had been returned by you, this great destruction of the very root and calamity with you and for us would not have happened."

40018996.author: पदार्थः
40018996.content: न्राता brother, वृत्तकामः desire fulfilled, भवेत् would be, रामः Rama, मित्रकुलम् turned to be friend, भवेत् would have been, वयम् our, सर्वाः all, अध्विनाः not widows, शत्रवः च enemy's, सकामाः that desire, न not

40018996.author: Translation
40018996.content: "If your brother's desire had been fulfilled Rama would have turned to be our friend. We would not have been widows. Our enemy's desire would not have been fulfilled."

40018997.author: पदार्थः
40018997.content: नृशंसेन with evil intention, सीताम् Sita, बलात् forcibly, संरुन्धता kept under detention, त्वयापुनः again by you, राक्षसाः Rakshasa, वयम् these आत्मा च and you too, त्रयम् three, तुल्यम् together, निपातितम् destroyed

40018997.author: Translation
40018997.content: "With evil intention you kept Sita under detention. These Rakshasas and you and us all the three are together destroyed."

40018998.author: पदार्थः
40018998.content: राक्षसपुङ्गवः foremost of Rakshasas, कामम् desire, तव of yours, कामकारः acting to your will, न वा by you, सर्वम् all, दैवम् divine, चेष्टयते makes you do, देवेन by divine, हतम् killed, हन्यते kills

40018998.author: Translation
40018998.content: "O Foremost of Rakshasas! You have acted according to your desire alone is not sufficient as divine will make you do everything. He is killed whom destiny kills."

40018999.author: पदार्थः
40018999.content: महाबाहो mighty armed, रणे in war, वानराणाम् Vanaras, राक्षसानां च Rakshasas also, तव च you too, अयम् this, विनाशः destruction, दैवयोगात् with the divine grace, उपागतः has come

40018999.author: Translation
40018999.content: "O mighty armed Ravana! For Vanaras, Rakshasas and you too, this destruction in this war has come by divine grace."

40019000.author: पदार्थः
40019000.content: उद्यता to lift up, दैवगतिः divine course, लोके in the world, अर्थेन by wealth, निवर्तयितुम् to stop, न शक्या not possible, कामेन with will, न not, विक्रमेण by prowess, न not, आज्ञया च king's order, न not

40019000.author: Translation
40019000.content: "In the world, to change the divine course of action, it is not possible with wealth, or will or by prowess or king's orders."
